firmwareNotes: Silent original WebGL2 instrument. No audio or notes. Generate exactly two set actions: cc71 labelled Warp and cc21 labelled Water ripples, each range 0-127, step 1, curve linear; and three trigger actions pattern0/pattern1/pattern2 sending program change 0/1/2. Every action expects sense camera, effect any. CC21 selects Water mode and changes ripple depth: forward/back hand motion creates expanding ripple waves. Pattern names: Flow, Rings, Prism. Do not substitute Warp or Rings for Water ripples.

sources.title: this repo: original visual synth implementation

usb.notes: Virtual MIDI-style output in the paired companion or simulated room; no USB permission required.

channels.receive: Channel 1. CC values 0-127. Program change 0-2 selects Flow, Rings, Prism. CC21 selects Water ripples and controls ripple depth. CC120/121/123 or panic resets all parameters and animation phase.

demo.visualFeedback: Camera compares the laptop screen's luma and colour before and after commands.
setup: Keep the paired Mac companion visible. Try visual synth in Quest opens its visual display automatically.
